purpose: Fresh powered confirmation after the 30-episode independent replication produced favorable but inconclusive estimates
sample_size_basis: The prior 30-episode replication gave episode-level SD 0.2720 for rolling-minus-FAR-Cal and 0.2405 for ACI-minus-FAR-Cal. Normal-approximation sizes for a positive two-sided 95% lower bound at the observed effects were 107 and 157; 160 fresh episodes were fixed before generation.
inference: Average paired effects across model and fault seeds within each episode, then bootstrap the 160 complete episodes with 2000 resamples.
superiority_rule: Both comparator-minus-candidate 95% episode-bootstrap lower bounds must exceed zero and candidate aggregate 90% coverage must be at least 0.88.
data_boundary: No episode with seed 60001 through 60160 existed in the confirmation directory when this registry was committed.
